title: Transcript count bound
statement: For every deterministic two-party protocol $p$, the number of its syntactic transcripts is at most $2$ raised to its communication complexity.
replaced:
For every deterministic two-party communication protocol $p$ with input types $X$ and
$Y$ and output type $\alpha$, the number of syntactic transcripts of $p$ is at most $2$
raised to its communication complexity:
\[
\abs{\mathrm{Transcript}(p)} \le 2^{\mathrm{complexity}(p)}.
\]
